cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I haven't booked our anniversary trip. Can you hear why before you get your laptop? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you just needed help with the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I let you think that. I was relieved when the cheap seats sold out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave the laptop shut. Is it the trip, or us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Us. I hoped a cancellation would say it for me. Can you still sit beside me while I explain?

mechanism: A directs a trip-planning conversation but yields its practical agenda while making increasingly vulnerable admissions that test B willingness to stay.
confusable: Unlike avoiding disclosure indefinitely, A actually admits a growing relationship problem; confident management softens into needing B continued presence.
comparison: Anniversary booking conceals relationship doubt, unlike a reunion absence concealing fear of being unwanted.
seedUse: D107-a flights, relief and relationship disclosure; S02-a tentative management and procedural accommodation.
